content: Gichkolune ga wa gigrokachine
Giyagni gichkolunwu wumkata gipxakletna rugrokinriyna wa mumkatkane. Gi wumkata gimutletnawa.
Satkakwu wixa gimutanru wumwastsitanru kigleruya tseruwakanshinikanutkalurupa.
Gi rixanu Kristo gi wa rumutnawa. Seyni wane china yongatyawaka:
Gi rixanu wixa chinanu yonatkaluru muchikawa yonatkalurpirankaka wyimakikolupa kashnantakgogneruya, giykolewluya yonchi giyakatyachri waneywu wixinripa wkagwaklepa.
Ga wa Goyakalu kashnantakgogneru, ruykolewle waneyalutu, genekangi panshinikanurungi gixinripa Kristo Gesoya.
Panshinikanurungi patokanurunepgi gimalwutyaplu Goyakalu Ruru Wutsrukate wixanu Geso Kristo.
Wale chinanupa waneyapna kagwaklewlena payineko
Giyagni Kristo yoptotingi pixkapotuko, gixa yoptokakletanu, rumalwutikolupa Goyakalu.
Gi rixanu wane nchina, kamrurewakleru rixka Kristo Geso sajruka gistaklewluya, tokanchi galikakpotunanu Goyakalupirana chinanu, poyegityaplu gitsrukaachinni gipiratikaluru.
Payineko gimalwutyaplu Goyakalu retwamonrewle chinanu. Chinyongatyawaka:

Gisayiya gimepetatnaka:
Wa kagwaklewlu Goyakalute genekpotutangi pejnuruko gimuwlu giglenshinikanrewlu galixinri. Tsru potu kagwaklewlu waneyapgi Giwekikaluru Kpashiri giyaklewleya.
Pawlo Goyakalu kamrurewyegitachri payine chinanu
Naponshinikanyegitgi, nomolene gitanune, wa gixa koxa kshinikanurunpotgi, psolpotukopirana gimatachinepgi, gimkata giykokakletinripa gixkakluko.
Psoji mkagwakpiratkatno nyonyegitgi, nomolene, wane nixa gishinkapkakletgi, gimutlewlu chinanu nenekikolu Goyakaluya.

Kristo Geso kamrurewyegitachripno payineyegiyako chinanu, Kiglerpotunanu Tokanchi Goyakalunu nkamruretinri. Payineko genekashatikolu gigleretkaluru rixinripa, kpashiri rixkaklewatinripa Giwekikaluru Kpashiriya.
Giyagni waneyno nalixkotpiranatyalu Kristo Gesoya Goyakalupirana.

Gi rixanu nkagwakpiratmaka yanumsayegletlu pagixanu pirana wa Kristo gi kamruta gitaya yijnakotinripna payineko tokanuyna, kamrureyna, ruyaklewleyma giglajrukakaya, getkalurkakaya, ruyaklewle Giwekikaluru Goyakalunu.
Wane rixa wa Gerosale ga wa psolsajrukleko Giririkpotunanuko nunkakletananumtlu psolchijneko Kiglerpotunanu Tokanchi Kristopirana.
Wane nixa muchkotletnawa nunkakletyaplu Kiglerpotunanu Tokanchi, ma koschekgiwakatikowakaya Kristo, gi wa satuna galpokotyawaka nkamrupjitinripa.
Seyni chinyongatyawaka:
Pawlo ginkakletlu wa Roma rushinikinri
Giyagni gixo kata numaletka gixa yegi nyinripa.
Ga wa xani gike nixatka tyesretkaka. Gixo walapu nalukpotutmaklu nyayegityagi.
Giyagni Gispanya nyinpatka, nyayegitangi. Gi rixanu nkagwaka getlemtgi nuknogamtinipa, ganikyapno waneya, nali getlemtinpatkagi.
Ga wa xani Gerosale nyanutka nupxakyapna kpashirine.
Gi rixanu Masetonya gajene, Gakayi gajene kigle getle rixluna genekashlu gitaklu kwamonurune kpashirine chinanu wa Gerosale gwachine.
Gi rixanu kigle getle rixluna nyi payineko. Ga wa galikaka rumkata gipekooyegletna Gerosale gajene, rapikonna chinanu kiglerkaka wannanu Giwekikaluruya. Payineko gimkata gipxaklekoxna gimaneyna.
Giyagni nnikatinpatkalu wa tye ga wa npoyegitinpatkalu tye kamrurchi, Gispanya nyinpatka, netamtangi xako.
Numatlu wa napyegitinipgi, Kristo giglenshinikanyegle potu numapokanu.
Pawlo gagjitna Roma gajene Kristonune ragjigognetinripna
Nkegemgayegitgi, nomolene, Wutsrukate Geso Kristoya, ga wa galuklewlu Giwekikaluruya, gipxakanno. Goyakalu gagjiyegitanno,
nushpakinripa malixkane Goteya gwachinyegiya; wa genekashlu kpashirine chinanu Gerosale gwachine, walenwa nkamruyegitanru, yoptotikolupa.
Gimuwatachripno napokyegitinipgi wa Goyakalu galukyawaka, gixaymananuko napnanutinripa.
Pejnurunekgi gixaymaplu giglenshinikanrewlu Goyakalute. Wane gixkalurupa.
